integrity: The finite upper bounds are obtained by exhaustive maximum-clique search over the complete compatibility graphs; deletion balls are reconstructed independently in two implementations and explicit optimal witnesses are included. No failed larger-length computation is used as evidence.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the ternary alphabet and lengths two through five; no claim is made for length six or larger or for two arbitrary nonconsecutive deletions. Originality remains subject to the residual risk of unindexed finite tables or differently phrased computations.
title: Exact initial ternary profile for correcting a burst of at most two deletions
